sloka: बलावमर्दस्त्वयि सन्निकृष्टे यथा गते शाम्यति शान्तशत्रौ ।तथा समीक्ष्यात्मबलं परं च समारभस्वास्त्रविदां वरिष्ठ ।। ५.४८.११।।।।
transliteration: balāvamardastvayi sannikṛṣṭe yathā gate śāmyati śāntaśatrau ।tathā samīkṣyātmabalaṁ paraṁ ca samārabhasvāstravidāṁ variṣṭha ।। 5.48.11।।।।

translations.english: "O hero take no large army as it is futile with this monkey endowed with extraordinary vigour. Even a thunderbolt can do nothing. He is like the wind and has no match in speed. He is like the sacrificial fire who cannot be destroyed by weapons.
translations.hindi: हैं शत्रुसूदन | पापी को मारने से पाप नहीं लगता । श्रतएव में इस पापकमं करने वाले वानर का वध करवाऊंगा
